title: Scalar composition is compatible with geometric comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme, A,B,C commutative rings in its independent coefficient universe, f:A -> B and g:B -> C ring homomorphisms, h:A -> C with e:h=g composed with f, and K any etale derived constant A-module. Write F for adicFinitePullback, E_et and E_pro for normalized scalar extension, s_et and s_pro for their specified reassociations, and theta for adicFiniteComparison [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. Then F_C(s_et(f,g,h,e)_K) followed by theta_h(K)^(-1) equals theta_g(E_et(f)K)^(-1), followed by E_pro(g)(theta_f(K)^(-1)), followed by s_pro(f,g,h,e)_(F_A K). No bounds or finiteness assumptions are made.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative P of K. Scalar extension and geometric inverse image preserve flat terms and K-flatness. All comparisons in the normalization formulas are therefore invertible.

Transport the ordinary and derived balancing normalizations along the specified coefficient-map equality. Apply the ordinary comparison composition theorem termwise to the representative complex. Paste the two scalar-composition normalization equations and the three scalar/geometric normalization equations. Naturality moves each computation map through this cube. Cancel the composite-scalar computation map and the final geometric computation map, which are isomorphisms on the chosen representative. This proves the forward comparison equation on every flat-term K-flat complex.

The resolving-natural-transformation extensionality lemma extends the forward comparison equation from flat-term K-flat complexes to all objects of the derived category, using their quasi-isomorphic resolutions. Finally cancel the component comparison isomorphisms to rewrite the forward equation as the asserted equation of inverse comparisons.

theorem adicComparison_composition (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A B C : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    (f : A →+* B) (g : B →+* C) (h : A →+* C) (e : h = g.comp f)
    (K : ConstantCompletion.D (constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A)) :
    (adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X C).map
        ((adicFiniteExtensionComp (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
          f g h e).hom.app K) ≫ (adicFiniteComparison.{u, v} X h).inv.app K =
      (adicFiniteComparison.{u, v} X g).inv.app
          ((adicFiniteExtension (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) f).obj K) ≫
        (adicFiniteExtension (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) g).map
          ((adicFiniteComparison.{u, v} X f).inv.app K) ≫
        (adicFiniteExtensionComp (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
          f g h e).hom.app ((adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X A).obj K)
